_about: demand: on the fps_tuner GPU power scale, a GPU with power == demand runs this game at ~100 FPS on High at 1080p. vram: GB needed for high textures. style: competitive targets high FPS, cinematic targets smooth 60+.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
tips: Lower 'Boost Player Contrast' only if you are GPU-limited; it helps visibility.
Use 'Shader Detail: Low' for the most stable frame times.

games.name: Dota 2
tips: Vulkan renderer is often smoother on AMD GPUs.

games.name: Apex Legends
tips: Model Detail Low makes enemies easier to spot.
Set 'Adaptive Resolution FPS Target' to 0 to keep the image sharp.

games.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
tips: Keep 'View Distance' high - it matters for spotting players.

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege
tips: Use the Vulkan executable for higher FPS on most systems.

games.name: Overwatch 2
tips: Turn on 'Reduce Buffering' for lower input lag.

games.name: Valorant
tips: This game is CPU-bound: close background apps for the biggest gain.

games.name: League of Legends
tips: Cap FPS at your refresh rate to save power and heat.

games.name: Fortnite
tips: 'Performance' rendering mode gives the highest FPS on older GPUs.

games.name: Marvel Rivals
tips: Turn off Global Illumination (Lumen) for a large FPS boost.

games.name: Call of Duty
tips: Set 'VRAM Scale Target' to 80% to avoid stutters.

games.name: Rust
tips: Lower 'Grass Displacement' and 'Draw Distance' first when FPS drops in towns.

games.name: Destiny 2
tips: Depth of field and motion blur off: free FPS, clearer image.

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
tips: 'Crowd Density' is the biggest CPU setting.
Screen Space Reflections Ultra/Psycho costs a lot for little gain - use High.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
tips: Volumetric settings (fog, lighting quality) are the most expensive - drop them first.
Use the Vulkan API for smoother frame times.

games.name: ELDEN RING
tips: The game is capped at 60 FPS - aim for a stable 60 rather than higher settings.

games.name: Baldur's Gate 3
tips: Act 3 is CPU-heavy - expect lower FPS in the city regardless of GPU.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V
tips: 'Extended Distance Scaling' costs a lot of CPU - keep it low.

games.name: HELLDIVERS 2
tips: Lower 'Render Scale' only as a last resort - use 'Quality' first.

games.name: Black Myth: Wukong
tips: Full ray tracing is only worth it on top-end cards.

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy
tips: Keep textures one step below max on 8 GB cards to avoid stutter.

games.name: Starfield
tips: Cities are CPU-bound; graphics settings change little there.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
tips: Use DirectX 11 mode on older GPUs for much higher FPS.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
tips: Terrain and object level of detail are the biggest performance settings.

games.name: Alan Wake 2
tips: Designed around upscaling - leave it on even on fast GPUs.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
tips: Turn on 'Dynamic Culling' to keep late-game fights smooth.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
tips: Keep texture quality within your VRAM - overflow causes heavy stutter.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
tips: 'Texture Pool Size' must fit in VRAM - lower it before anything else.

games.name: Satisfactory
tips: Large factories are CPU-bound; lower 'Network Quality' in multiplayer.

games.name: Valheim
tips: Big bases slow the CPU, not the GPU - graphics settings help little there.

games.name: Stardew Valley
tips: Runs on almost anything - max it out.

games.name: Minecraft
tips: Render distance is the biggest setting - 12-16 chunks is the sweet spot.
